c2_bad.why: Hold-repeat pacing for rails and grids (cards per second, page-jump for long lists) is the p5-09 defect, not a two-column track chooser; selected only to cover dpad_reachability/focus_visible.
Repeat of the c1 miss: virtualisation, image sizing and 'never coalesce key events' are irrelevant to a track chooser, and it still delivers table.virtualization, a forbidden concept for this task.

why: The new comp-tv-side-sheet record states almost exactly what the implementer had to supply from own knowledge in c1 (first focus on the current value, selected = fill + check + semantics distinct from the focus ring, BACK returns focus to the opening button, current choice shown next to the button, Off row and a no-tracks state, controls not auto-hiding while the sheet is open), closing both c1 critical concept misses (interaction.selection_visible, a11y.dialog_focus), and the direction no longer proposes icon-custom-glyphs or metadata-focus-reveal against the codebase.
